certification_rule: Direct LLD05-T/F markers are retrieval aids only. Packet certification requires all 91 normative cases to remain semantically bound to the exact accepted design, the implementation head to pass the supported Ubuntu/Windows matrix with the exact design pin, and no unresolved cross-packet subclause.
method: All 48 acceptance and 43 failure-injection scenarios are enumerated from the exact accepted LLD-05 design authority.
Every case is bound to production owner paths and executable regressions after semantic inspection; marker/file presence alone is never certification.
Cases whose test names predate direct LLD05-T/F markers are retained as manual semantic bindings rather than receiving redundant marker-only tests.
Cross-packet transaction/source/dependency clauses are proved through real LLD-03/04/07 integration tests and remain explicitly labeled instead of being inferred from mocks.

T008 was design-reconciled to make manual exact-touch merge request authority explicit and is implemented through the existing proposal/acceptance pipeline; automatic exact-touch grouping remains separate.
T002 and T006 received focused semantic regressions because their prior evidence covered the implementation invariant but not the complete public acceptance story.
